Title: [LSJ] i cam accros this stupid Jack question

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
hi :)
The problem almost happened, so i have to ask the question.

I control Jack with a Zillah's tears on him.
during my master phase, i want to put a KRCG News radio in play but i'm
low on pool.
can i tap jack once, the untap him with zillah's tears, then tap him
again to reduce the KRCG's cost to zero ? :)

thank you !

Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:


I believe that falls under the "card in play" rule. You can only use
any card's special once per turn unless otherwise specified. So, no.

Jeff

>any card's special once per turn unless otherwise specified. So, no.

What "card in play" rule? The repeat actions one? Only applies to
actions.

If the special said "During your master phase, you may tap Jack to..."
it'd be restricted to once. But if you can untap him during your master
phase (after tapping him the first time), you can use his special twice.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


I'll jump in and wager on my own opinion that you can't burn the
Zillah's Tears during the playing of a master card. That is, unless a
card has specific text to the contrary (Jack, Sudden Reversal), there's
no window in which to interrupt the effect.

Compare and contrast: If I control the Barrens (untapped), and you play
the Barrens, there's no window in which I could tap the Barrens before
contesting starts.

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: quetzalcoatl
Messages.Body:
Personally I would say you could pull this off.

Zillah's Tears
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready Sabbat vampire. Put this card on
this acting vampire and move 1 blood from the blood bank to this
vampire. This Sabbat vampire can burn this card any time after this
turn ends to untap. A vampire can have only one Zillah's Tears.

Jack
Sabbat - Torrance Circle: You may tap Jack when you play a Master:
Location (unique or not) to reduce the cost of that location by 1 pool.
+1 strength. Sterile.

Zillah's Tears mentions nothing about interruption (c.f. Heidleburg -
it does) of an action or a play.

So the sequence would most likely go:

I play KRCG. During the play I tap Jack. I am now currently paying 1
pool for it. Still during the play I burn Zillah's and tap Jack again.
My cost is 0 pool. I pay my 0 pool, the playing of the KRCG is over.

David

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <pyZ9e.570$Od6....@news.xtra.co.nz>, carl


That's not an action. Repeat action applies to actions. Tapping a
vampire for a special ability is not an action.

If you can untap him, you can use him twice. As LSJ has pointed out,
however, you can't use it on the same cost as you can't interrupt the
payment like that.
